Compiled by the Dharma-transmitting Chan Master Foguo, Abbot of Fayan Chan Monastery in Dongjing (Subject Wei Bai).
Continued Lamp Record of Jianzhong Jingguo, Scroll One.

I. The Gate of the Orthodox Lineage (*Zhengzongmen*): A direct narration of the causes and conditions of realization as transmitted by the patriarchs of India and this land, setting forth the essential purport of the lineage.

II. The Gate of Responding to Capacities (*Duījīmén*): The various masters and exemplars of the quarters who, through their "cracking and pecking" responses to stimuli, proclaimed the principles of the lineage and elucidated the essentials of the mind.

III. The Gate of Citing the Past (*Niángǔmén*): Those possessed of great knowledge and vision who, by citing and highlighting the teachings and lineages, extolled or suppressed the predecessors and opened the way for future generations.

The fourth is the Section on Verses on Ancient Cases (*songgu men*): (The profound and abstruse teachings of former masters are brought forth through verse; their words and meanings are systematic, and their fundamental principles are unerring.

The fifth is the Section on Gāthā Verses (*jiesong men*): (The inner and outer insights of realized ones of past and present are clearly elucidated; these chapters on singing the Way are recorded as a model for emulation. The Section on the True Lineage (*zhengzong men*).
